components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Role Register
components.description: Three-role professional register, vertical on desktop and horizontal at compact widths.
components.css: .ds-role-register { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); width: 6.25rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.9rem 2rem 0; border-right: 1px solid #b8b4aa; color: #66645e; font: 600 0.7rem/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-role-register span { display: flex; min-height: 8.25rem; border-left: 1px solid #b8b4aa; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-role-register span:first-child { border-left: 0; }

components.name: Proof Ledger

components.css: .ds-proof-ledger { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid #11110f; border-bottom: 1px solid #11110f; background: #f3f0e8; color: #11110f; } .ds-proof-ledger div { padding: 1rem 1.4rem 1.1rem; border-right: 1px solid #b8b4aa; } .ds-proof-ledger div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-proof-ledger dd { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(2.7rem, 4vw, 4.5rem)/0.85 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-proof-ledger dt { margin-top: 0.55rem; color: #66645e; font: 400 0.72rem/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The system feels like a product launch dossier built from field evidence, not a centered personal-brand homepage. Warm paper, near-black ink, compressed display typography, thin rules, and square geometry create a factual editorial surface with a clear point of view.

Deep indigo marks decisive actions and high-confidence evidence. Factual project and publication imagery, structured outcomes, and visible metrics make product leadership, design, go-to-market work, and frontend delivery read as one connected practice.

Density stays deliberate. Oversized type and the asymmetric role register establish identity, while ledgers and indices make the record easy to scan. Depth appears only when an overlay detaches from the document plane, and purposeful motion reinforces structure while respecting reduced-motion preferences.
keyCharacteristics: Compressed display type against calm body copy.
Square, ruled paper geometry with softly rounded actions and one deep indigo accent.
A vertical desktop role register that becomes horizontal responsively.
Factual imagery and motion that confirms structure, never decorates.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Biography Rule
rules.body: Lead with observable work, outcomes, and artifacts before relying on professional labels.

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Use deep indigo for decisive actions, selected evidence, and major closing surfaces; its rarity carries authority.

rules.name: The Factual Color Rule
rules.body: Project media may be toned or cropped, but never recolored into decorative or invented imagery.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed carries every oversized claim and index title; body copy never imitates it through tracking or all caps.

rules.name: The Responsive Register Rule
rules.body: Preserve hierarchy and reading order when vertical desktop labels become horizontal; do not preserve desktop novelty at the cost of mobile comprehension.

rules.name: The Detached Sheet Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only when an overlay leaves the page plane; inline panels stay flat and use borders or contrast instead.

rules.name: The Square Proof Rule
rules.body: Document surfaces, media crops, and overlays keep square corners; actions alone may soften to 12px for clearer affordance.

rules.name: The Motion With Purpose Rule
rules.body: Animate rule growth, evidence reveal, and overlay entry only; reduced motion removes spatial starts and preserves immediate feedback.

dos: Do use verified local WebP imagery and retain enough publication context for the evidence to remain honest.
Do pair one filled deep-indigo primary action with a ruled secondary action.
Do reserve Barlow Condensed 700 for oversized statements, headings, project names, and dialog titles.
Do preserve semantic reading order before applying grid offsets, vertical writing, or responsive rearrangement.
Do use thin rules, background contrast, and type scale to separate inline content.
donts: Don't recenter the first impression into a generic personal-brand cover.
Don't add portraits, stock imagery, generic AI imagery, decorative gradients, glass cards, pills, or rounded card systems.
Don't use shadows on inline cards, ledgers, sections, or media.
Don't animate for ornament or leave spatial motion active when the user prefers reduced motion.
Don't invent metrics, customers, testimonials, benchmarks, or project visuals.
